verdict.rationale: An in-engine AI assistant is a fair question for a game/rendering engine with first-party tooling such as the Playground, Inspector and Node Material Editor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an official AI assistant for generating scripts, answering API questions or scaffolding scenes. The llms.txt files only make the docs machine-readable for outside LLMs, and the runtime probe finds no official MCP server either.
